text: Jokkee onon ɓee yimɓe, Deftere nde Joomi mon Jippini e mooɗon e sunna Annabiijo mon on, wata on jokku mbeleeɗe ɓen ɓe sikkoton ko weldiiɓe mo'on -immorde e seytaaneeji maa ruuɗinkiniiɓe- Kono fanɗii ko waajitotoɗon ; tawde si on waajitino, on ɓurnataano goɗɗum goo e goonga kan, on jokkayno ko Nulaaɗo mon on addani on kon, gollitiron ɗum, hawkon ko lunndii ɗum.
